name: Cal.com development
description: Every worktree gets its own Postgres database (a copy of the main one when migrations match), its own .env, URL and ports, a dev server, and Prisma Studio on demand. Removing the worktree drops its database.

requires.hint: Cal.com's Node version, e.g. through nvm or fnm
optional: without it (or Postgres in Docker) worktrees migrate and seed a fresh database instead of copying the main one
